question: The Braj festival in _______ is held every year for two days in the Shukla Paksha of the Phalgun month, a few days before Holi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Braj festival **is celebrated in **Rajasthan** every year.
 
• It is held for two days in the **Shukla Paksha of the Phalgun month**, which is a few days before Holi.
 
• This festival is known for its vibrant colors, traditional music, and dance, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Rajasthan.
 
• Devotees and tourists from various parts of India and the world come to participate in this festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Braj festival is associated with the legends of** Radha and Krishna**, and many events during the festival depict their divine love.
 
• It is celebrated with great enthusiasm in the towns of **Bharatpur, Deeg, and Kaman** in Rajasthan.
 
• During the festival, people engage in activities like Raslila dance and singing traditional songs, which are integral parts of the celebrations.
 
• The festival also features processions, folk performances, and various cultural programs that highlight the traditions of Braj Bhoomi.
